sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Certified Good Distribution Practice (GDP) Clinical Logistics

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Samoa (unitary national jurisdiction; offshore and international finance regime administered by the Samoa International Finance Authority, SIFA)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Common Law (English common law heritage modified by Samoan statutes; final appellate jurisdiction vested in the Court of Appeal of Samoa)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Marrakesh Agreement Establishing the World Trade Organization (Samoa acceded 10 May 2012)
Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters (OECD/Council of Europe; in force for Samoa from 1 August 2015)
Samoa–New Zealand Double Taxation Agreement (bilateral; current status to be confirmed against Samoa Inland Revenue records)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (No. 12 of 1987), as amended to 2020; Anti-Money Laundering and Proliferation Financing Act 2007, as amended; Proceeds of Crime Act 2001; FIU AML/CFT Rules and Guidance Notes (current consolidated edition); SIFA Beneficial Ownership and Customer Due Diligence Directives (current edition); International Companies (Forms and Fees) Regulations, as amended.
ubo_and_aml_profiling.ubo_disclosure_level: Government_Only_Access (not public; beneficial ownership data is held by the licensed registered agent and must be produced to SIFA, the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) and competent authorities upon lawful request)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of valid passport or national identity card of each beneficial owner, proposed director and authorised signatory
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the country of residence (e.g., Notary Public Office, PRC)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization — Samoa is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; the chain is notarization, authentication by the PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs (Apostille cognisable for China-only purposes from 7 November 2023 but not binding on Samoa), followed by legalization through a Samoan diplomatic mission or authorized honorary consul (e.g., Embassy in Brussels, High Commission in Wellington or Canberra, Honorary Consul in Hong Kong)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Banker's professional reference letter for each beneficial owner and director (original letter-head, dated and signed by an authorized bank officer)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed bank maintaining the account relationship of the beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarization and Consular Legalization where the bank requires it; alternatively accepted by the registered agent as a certified true copy if bearing original bank stamp and branch authority certificate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing and Register of Directors of any corporate shareholder (e.g., Hong Kong or other foreign parent entity)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the corporate shareholder's jurisdiction (e.g., Hong Kong Companies Registry)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where the issuing registry sits in an Apostille Convention state, plus notarized English translation; otherwise full Consular Legalization through the relevant consular channel; SIFA reserves the right to require additional verification

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: SIFA-compliant Due Diligence Questionnaire and UBO Declaration (SIFA standard forms, signed by each UBO)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed Samoa registered agent (issuance and attestation)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Agent attestation in Samoa; no notarization or consular step is required, but the agent must witness signatures and retain the original in the compliance file

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs, directors, authorised signatories and material counterparties against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, OFAC SDN List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List and Samoa domestic sanctions alerts; PEP identification extends to family members and close associates in accordance with FATF Recommendation 12; any PEP, high-risk-jurisdiction nexus or negative screening hit triggers enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval and documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds evidence; screening is conducted at onboarding and refreshed on an ongoing risk-based cycle with a minimum annual re-screening requirement.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) – Registrar of International Companies; filings are agent-mediated; no public self-service online registry is operated, and name availability is confirmed by SIFA through a licensed registered agent upon formal application
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The registered statutory name must be expressed in Latin (Roman) letters; a parallel Chinese-character name may be adopted in the company's constitutional documents for client and banking convenience, provided a notarised English-Chinese transliteration and translation is delivered to the registered agent; the Latin-script name is the sole controlling statutory name for SIFA purposes
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Within 14 days of a rejection notice, the applicant's licensed registered agent may file a written request for reconsideration with SIFA, attaching evidence that the proposed name is distinguishable from existing registrations or that the requisite ministerial or Central Bank consent has been obtained; SIFA must respond within 15 working days; a further administrative appeal may be pursued by way of judicial review in the Supreme Court of Samoa under common law principles.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Not permitted for International Companies: a physical registered office in Samoa at the premises of a licensed registered agent is mandatory under the International Companies Act 1987; a remote or virtual-office-only arrangement does not satisfy the statutory threshold
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low — quantified at less than 5% annual probability for the newly-incorporated entity itself; SIFA conducts risk-based and periodic inspections of licensed registered agents, and unannounced on-site inspection of the client entity is effectively nil because an International Company maintains no physical Samoan premises beyond the registered agent's office

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: SIFA name search and name reservation fee (one name, single filing)
SIFA incorporation government registration fee (authorised share capital up to USD 1,000,000)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: International Companies (Forms and Fees) Regulations, current SIFA fee schedule

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Licensed registered agent first-year onboarding and compliance retainer
Physical registered office provision in Samoa (first year)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark component of registered office service

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year SIFA annual government levy (offshore company annual licence)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: SIFA annual fee schedule, current tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/KYC and UBO identification file preparation (CDD collection, beneficial ownership analysis, risk classification, file maintenance)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed Samoa registered agent compliance desk
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark for standard-risk IC onboarding

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: PEP and sanctions screening subscription (UN, OFAC, EU and national lists; onboarding plus first annual refresh)
Notarization, PRC MFA authentication and Samoa Consular Legalization bundle for Chinese-issued owner/director documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: PRC Notary Public, PRC Ministry of Foreign Affairs, Samoan diplomatic/consular representative
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing Chinese notarial and consular service fees plus courier handling

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Company seal, certified true copies of constitutional documents and certificate of incorporation
International courier of original executed documents to and from Samoa

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended by the International Companies Amendment Act 2016; ss. 5-9 (Application for Incorporation, Memorandum, and Certificate of Incorporation); s. 46 (Registered Office and Registered Agent)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Companies Office, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the International Company, together with Application for Incorporation (Form ICD-01) delivered to the Registrar
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum or authorized capital floor; minimum of one no-par-value share; paid-up capital may be zero at incorporation and will be determined by the subscriber directors; no escrow or paid-up deposit requirement under the International Companies Act 1987
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the subscribers listed in the Memorandum of Association be and are hereby allotted the initial ordinary shares set out opposite their names, and the consideration recorded in the share register is approved; (2) That the registered office of the Company be established at the office of [Registered Agent] in Apia, Samoa, and the Registered Agent is authorized to act as agent for service of process; (3) That [Name] be and is hereby appointed as the sole Director and [Name] as Company Secretary, each to hold office until removed by resolution; (4) That the Directors adopt the draft minute book, share certificates, and statutory registers and are authorized to open bank accounts for GDP pharma logistics operations.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Corporate Name Reservation and Restricted-Word Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia (counter and online portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application via the MCIL Companies Office; the proposed name must end with 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Corp.', 'Incorporated' or 'Inc.'; restricted words such as 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Insurance' and 'Pharmaceutical' require written no-objection clearance from the Samoa Ministry of Health or the Central Bank of Samoa before reservation.
required_dossiers: Subscriber and initial director identification particulars
Ministry of Health no-objection letter (if name references pharma or clinical logistics)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused, file an amended name application within 5 business days; no re-filing fee is charged for the first alternative name proposed in the original application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Notarization of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Samoa notary public or licensed attorney; counter validation by the Registrar of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum stating the company name, registered office location, share capital structure, and permitted objects, and the Articles prescribing director powers, quorum, and indemnity; each subscriber must sign in the presence of a notary who shall endorse the attestation page; a Chinese-language annex may be attached as a translation for full-Chinese-charter client support.
required_dossiers: Consent to act from each director and secretary
Beneficial ownership register particulars (Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act 2012, as amended)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries an ultra-vires or defective clause, amend the affected page, re-execute the signature page before the notary, and re-submit the revised memorandum or articles within 7 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Statutory Filing, Government Fee Payment, and Registration Docket
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Deliver Form ICD-01, the notarized memorandum and articles, notice of registered office, and subscriber declarations; pay the USD 100 government incorporation fee by direct bank transfer to the MCIL Companies Office account or at the counter; request a file-stamped receipt and docket reference.
required_dossiers: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Notice of registered office and registered agent in Samoa
Declaration of the registered agent accepting the agency
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a procedural deficiency note, cure the stated deficiency within 14 days to avoid abandonment; no penalty applies to a first-instance cure.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and National Registry Entry
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL Companies Office, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation, enters the company particulars into the national corporate register, and returns a file-stamped copy of the memorandum; the company may then adopt a common seal and procure the statutory minute book and registers.
required_dossiers: Proof of payment of the USD 100 filing fee
Approved incorporation docket with file-stamped memorandum
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains incorrect metadata or a defective company name spelling, apply to the Registrar for formal rectification under the International Companies Act within 30 days of issue.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Completion of First Board Governance and Statutory Records
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent or licensed corporate secretary in Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the First Board meeting to subscribe shares, adopt the registered office arrangement, appoint officers, issue share certificates, and open the statutory registers (directors, shareholders, charges, beneficial ownership); deposit all records at the registered agent's office and open an operational bank account capable of supporting Swift Wire and Direct ACH payment rails.
required_dossiers: Signed minutes of the First Board Resolution
Statutory registers maintained at the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the director or officer appointment filing is defective, submit Form ICD-10 to update the registered officers; late filings are cured within 14 days subject to a discretionary minor late fee waiver.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Medicines and Health Products Regulatory Section, Ministry of Health (MOH), Samoa, acting through the Pharmacy and Poisons Board under the Medicines Act 2007
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Wholesale Medicine Distribution (Good Distribution Practice) Licence — Import, Export, Storage and Arranged Transport of Medicines for Clinical Freight Logistics

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa, in coordination with the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Registration-tier / Managed Activity under the Planning and Urban Management Act 2004 and the Environment Impact Assessment Regulations; a Full EIA Report is required only if the cold-chain warehouse construction exceeds the development threshold or is sited within a sensitive ecological or coastal zone; otherwise an EIA Registration Statement and development consent suffice.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Compliance with Samoa wastewater standards for washdown and cleaning effluents (BOD not exceeding 50 mg/L and TSS not exceeding 50 mg/L prior to discharge); prohibition on CFC and HCFC refrigerant release in temperature-controlled units, with phased conversion to HFC or hydrocarbon systems; diesel backup generator emissions registered and controlled in accordance with MNRE air-quality conditions; waste pharmaceuticals and damaged cold-chain products consigned exclusively to licensed hazardous waste handlers under the Waste Management Act 2005.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA) following annual inspection of the temperature-controlled warehouse, including evacuation plans and suppression system certification; structural load inspection and building code compliance clearance from the Planning and Urban Management Agency (PUMA); occupational safety and health certificate of clearance from the MCIL Occupational Safety and Health Division, covering workplace HAZMAT training, spill-containment verification, and personal protective equipment protocols for GDP pharma freight personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry for Revenue of Samoa (Samoa Tax Administration); official eServices portal: https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity shall apply for a Tax Identification Number (TIN) using the prescribed application form to the Ministry for Revenue. The application must be submitted within 30 days after the entity becomes liable for any Samoa tax, or before making its first taxable supply for VAGST. The entity must submit certified copies of its certificate of incorporation, registered office confirmation, director identification documents, and an authorised business activity declaration. The TIN and, if applicable, VAGST registration certificate are issued upon verification; foreign entities may apply in person, by mail, or through a licensed tax agent.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Under the International Companies Act 1987, the tax exemption is automatic and does not require an election. Samoa domestic law does not provide a check-the-box mechanism. Voluntary VAGST registration is possible where a person makes or intends to make taxable supplies below the mandatory threshold. Samoa has no specific hybrid mismatch election legislation under OECD BEPS.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 500,000 (Samoan Tala and Sene) in taxable turnover within a 12-month period; non-resident suppliers of digital services to Samoa may be subject to special registration thresholds as prescribed by the Ministry for Revenue.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance mandate requires an API-based submission or digital stamping. Tax invoices must satisfy the prescribed particulars under the Goods and Services Tax Act 2003, including supplier TIN, recipient TIN, invoice date, description of supply, consideration, and VAGST amount. The Ministry for Revenue accepts paper invoices and electronic invoices issued through approved commercial systems; no fiscal stamp or real-time clearance API is currently in force.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to goods physically exported from Samoa within 30 days of supply, and to services supplied to non-resident persons where the services are consumed entirely outside Samoa, including international freight and related GDP logistics services. The taxpayer must retain evidence of export, such as customs endorsement, bills of lading, or air waybills, and demonstrate that the recipient is not resident in Samoa and is not registered for VAGST in Samoa. For freight services, the supply must relate to transportation of goods between Samoa and a foreign country, or where transport commences or terminates in Samoa and the recipient is a non-resident.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration, Bill of Lading, Inward Remittance Certificate
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims for export zero-rating or refunds attract a penalty of up to 200% of the evaded tax, a monetary penalty not exceeding WST 50,000, and/or imprisonment for a term up to three years under the Tax Administration Act 2019. Retrospective clawback applies to any refund paid in respect of a supply subsequently found not to satisfy zero-rating conditions, together with statutory interest at the prescribed rate. Customs and revenue audits verify export endorsements, foreign currency repatriation, and supporting transactional records.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (CBS), acting also as the Exchange Control Authority under the Exchange Control Act 1979 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1980; the Minister of Finance retains residual licensing and exemption powers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) operates under a managed-float regime. Current-account payments, including consultancy fees, freight, insurance, and similar bona fide service transactions, are normally market-convertible upon documentary verification. Profit remittance requires exchange-control authorization when the entity is a Samoan resident; an International Company incorporated under the International Companies Act 1987 is exempt from Samoan exchange control on foreign-currency transactions, provided it does not trade with Samoan residents and maintains comprehensive beneficial ownership and source-of-funds records. Capital-account convertibility is selective: inbound direct investment and share subscriptions generally require no separate CBS permit for an International Company, but outward capital repatriation and conversion of surplus WST assets require an exchange-control authorization and an up-to-date tax-exemption certificate.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: A resident exporter must repatriate export proceeds within 90 days from shipment and surrender foreign currency to an authorized dealer for conversion into WST unless a CBS exemption or a retained-foreign-currency-account permission is granted. Non-resident International Companies used for GDP pharma freight are generally outside the resident surrender rule; export income may remain in designated USD, EUR, or WST accounts if the licensed bank files a standing exemption certificate with CBS and maintains fully documented trade files.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: International Company USD/WST Capital Escrow and Settlement Account
Operational Account for GDP Logistics Receivables and Payables
Operational and Escrow Account with Documentary Credit Capacity

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low. Samoa does not have a dedicated electronic-money institution licence, and CBS does not permit standalone fintech EMIs to participate directly in the WST clearing settlement. A licensed cross-border EMI can act only as a channelling payment provider passing funds into a real Samoan bank account, not as a clearing-rail settlement institution. Any offshore EMI balance should be treated strictly as credit exposure, not as alternative liquidity infrastructure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: CBS prudential expectations require at least one natural-person director or an authorised signatory with sign-off authority to appear for an in-person verification interview at the bank's Apia office. Remote opening is permitted only in narrow circumstances where the applicant already holds a substantive banking relationship with a correspondent institution, the bank's internal AML committee approves a video interview, and independent certification/legalisation of the corporate documents is completed. A cooling-off and enhanced due-diligence period of generally ten business days applies before settlement accounts are activated.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Benefits from a discretionary or express trust without transparent ultimate beneficial ownership disclosure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full trust deed and any amendments, registered agent's AML due-diligence file, signed group structure chart, UBO declaration certified by a licensed Samoan trustee, notarised passport copies of all discretionary beneficiaries, and a source-of-wealth statement for each beneficiary.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Pharma freight invoice values materially above market benchmarks or frequent same-day counterparty switching between unrelated jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: GDP storage and shipping thermal-sensor logs, signed WHO/GDP proof-of-delivery records, bank reference on the third-party logistics provider, cargo insurance certificate, and the matched Customs Cargo Import/Export Declaration.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Transactions involving high-risk payment corridors or sanctions-adjacent transshipment hubs.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Full-product trade compliance screening using WCO tariff line granularity, global sanctions screen report, consignee UBO evidence, CBS/PSC contact memorandum, and the GDP-pharma handling licence of the physical warehouse operator.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inbound capital subscription before the bank has completed tax-exempt status and economic substance review.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certificate of Incorporation, Memorandum and Articles of Association, share register, tax-exemption certificate, registered-agent undertaking, board resolution authorising the capital call, and the complete MT103 wire path showing source and purpose of funds.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Use SWIFT MT103/MT202 wire transfers routed through an authorised dealer with clear ISO 20022 purpose codes such as INVEST for direct-investment capital contributions or TRAD for trade facilitation. No WST bearer instruments and no local cash injections are acceptable for an International Company foreign-currency account. The receiving bank requires the share-subscription board resolution, a written capital-introduction letter from the beneficial owner, the Samoan registered agent's AML file, and confirmation that the funds are not sourced from a jurisdiction under FATF monitoring. Funds should pass directly to the licensed IC bank account; intermediary chains should be limited to no more than one correspondent hop and any offshore EMI must be disclosed as a payment processor rather than a settlement bank.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Pharmaceutical freight suppliers should be settled by irrevocable documentary letter of credit issued through a Samoan licensed bank and transmitted by SWIFT MT700, or by a direct SWIFT MT103 with full beneficiary due diligence and all supporting trade-contract references. For domestic Samoan pharmacies, local WST obligations are cleared through the Samoan interbank clearing system using Direct ACH/credit transfer in WST. Cross-border supplier payments remain dependent on the SWIFT correspondent banking network, and every MT103 must carry the purchase order, LC reference, and GDP freight-tracking reference to avoid post-transaction exchange-control queries.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Plain-vanilla USD/WST forward contracts with an authorised dealer, maturity up to 12 months
Non-deliverable WST forwards (NDFs) executed offshore with approved financial institutions when local WST forward liquidity is insufficient
Cross-currency swaps between USD, EUR, and WST for medium-term treasury receivables and payables
Costless option collars, subject to prior CBS notification for resident entities and internal bank credit approval for International Companies

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: International Company Annual Renewal Return and Annual Government Fee
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Services Authority (SIFSA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 May each calendar year; newly incorporated International Companies pay the first annual fee at incorporation, covering the period to the next 31 May deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late surcharge of 10% of the annual fee applies after 31 May; continued non-payment for three months may result in suspension from the International Companies Register, and six months of continued non-payment may lead to administrative strike-off and dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Declaration, Statutory Register Audit, and UBO Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed Samoa Registered Agent maintaining the registered office and statutory records on behalf of the International Company
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On the anniversary of incorporation, or within 30 days of the anniversary date as required by the registered agent engagement and SIFSA compliance rules
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to certify statutory registers and beneficial ownership records may result in an adverse compliance report to SIFSA, regulatory penalties, a default notice, and potential court-ordered strike-off for repeated non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual GDP Pharma Freight Licence and Cold-Chain Logistics Validation Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa Ministry of Health, Regulatory Authority, in coordination with Customs and Border Control for pharmaceutical freight clearance
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually prior to 31 December, or on the date stated in the issued GDP Pharma Freight licence; a new validation must be completed within 60 days of any material change to storage or transport procedures
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Expired GDP validation suspends lawful pharmaceutical freight handling, exposes the operator to import and export stoppages, administrative fines, and possible revocation of the logistics licence.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Samoa International Companies are exempt from compulsory financial audit and from public filing of financial statements unless the company's constitution, shareholders, or a specific regulatory directive require an audit. A voluntary audit may be advisable where pharmaceutical GDP freight contracts or banking counterparties demand certified financial statements.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No Samoa local GAAP is mandatory for International Companies; financial records may be maintained under IFRS or another recognized GAAP. The International Companies Act 2008 requires books and records sufficient to present a true and fair view of financial position, but does not mandate adoption of a specific framework.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Every International Company must maintain a current beneficial ownership register through its licensed registered agent. The registered agent must conduct an annual confirmation and update the register, including verification of any shareholding transfers during the year. A share transfer must be entered in the Register of Members and reported to the registered agent within 30 days of the transfer. The annual UBO confirmation is delivered as part of the anniversary compliance package and may be inspected by SIFSA.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 2,500 - 6,000 per annum for a voluntary statutory-quality audit, depending on transaction volume and GDP warehouse operations

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% (applicable to resident companies; International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt under s.119 International Companies Act 1987)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate for International Companies engaged in qualifying offshore business; no income tax, capital gains tax, withholding tax or stamp duty. Annual Government license fees apply. No additional tax holidays provided.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: MCIL Form IC-AR (Annual Return of International Company) filed through the Samoa Companies Online Portal (SCOP) of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL): https://www.mcil.gov.ws
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 30 days after each anniversary of the date of incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full registered name of the International Company exactly as stated in the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Input the legal name from the certificate; no modifications or abbreviations unless registered as an alternative name.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Samoa International Companies Register registration number (CRN).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Insert the 8-digit CRN issued by the Registrar; verify on the public register before submission.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa (physical location, not a P.O. Box).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must be the address maintained by the licensed registered agent in Samoa; provide the street address and identify the agent's office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The agent must hold a current International Company Service Provider licence; state the license number exactly as shown on the agent's licence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Particulars of directors and secretary (full names, nationalities, residential addresses, and passport or ID numbers).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide all requested data for non-resident directors; a company secretary is mandatory and may be a natural person or a licensed corporate services entity.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of compliance: confirmation that the IC has not carried on business in Samoa and has not engaged in regulated activities requiring a Samoa licence (banking, insurance, trust, etc.).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any local activity has occurred, attach a Schedule and consult a Samoa tax attorney; making a false declaration is a criminal offence.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Annual Government license fee calculation and Ministry of Revenue receipt reference.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the WST amount paid for the current anniversary year and attach the payment receipt generated by the Samoa Ministry of Revenue portal.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing incurs WST 150 per month or part thereof (capped at WST 1,800); daily surcharge of WST 25 after a 30-day grace period; failure for 6 months or more may lead to administrative strike-off, forfeiture of assets, and director travel bans.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory dividend withholding tax for resident companies; 0% for International Companies under s.119 IC Act 1987 (exempt from withholding tax on dividends paid to non-residents).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: ICs do not require treaty relief because dividends are statutorily exempt. For a standard resident company, DTA relief is obtained by (i) applying to the Samoa Ministry of Revenue for a Certificate of Tax Residency (TRC) with Form WHT-3, (ii) providing the TRC and a beneficial-ownership declaration to the paying agent, and (iii) filing the reduced WHT rate within 30 days of the distribution. Samoa's DTAs generally require the recipient to be a resident and beneficially own the dividend.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates: royalties 15%, interest 15% (non-residents, no treaty); ICs are exempt from both. Under Samoa's income tax law (including the Taxes Administration Act 2015), interest and royalties paid by a tax-exempt IC remain free from withholding if the IC has no Samoa-source income and meets the IC Act exemption.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: WST 1,000,000 annual aggregate controlled transactions (for resident companies under Samoa's Transfer Pricing Regulations 2012). ICs are not subject to CIT TP documentation; however, if the IC is an ESR-resident entity for substance purposes, related-party transactions must be reported to the Registrar for substance assessment.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Yes. Samoa's Economic Substance Regulations 2020 (ESR) apply to International Companies carrying on 'relevant activities.' The GDP clinical logistics and pharma freight business qualifies as a 'distribution and service centre' activity if revenues are derived from related-party logistics services. The IC must maintain in Samoa: (i) a physical office or premises; (ii) full-time employees with appropriate GDP and logistics qualifications; (iii) CORE income-generating activities (dispatch, quality control, temperature validation) managed in Samoa; and (iv) operating expenditure proportionate to the level of activity. An annual ESR notification and report must be filed with the Registrar; failure attracts penalties and automatic exchange of information with foreign tax authorities.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting Samoa-source trade or business (e.g., local pharma warehousing, inland freight, or handling of goods in Samoa) through an International Company without a domestic business registration or CIT filing, while wrongfully claiming the s.119 tax exemption.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Loss of tax exemption; retroactive reassessment at 27% corporate tax on all Samoa-source profits; penalty of 150% of unpaid tax under s.32 Taxes Administration Act 2015; criminal fine of up to WST 200,000.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors jointly and severally liable for the unpaid tax, interest, and penalties; the Ministry of Revenue may issue a certificate of debt and impose a travel ban; conviction for tax evasion carries imprisonment of up to 5 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining IC status without any physical office, employees, or board meetings in Samoa while engaging in related-party GDP logistics activities (distribution and service centre), violating the Samoa ESR 2020.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalties from WST 20,000 to WST 100,000 per annum per relevant activity; the Registrar may strike off the IC after 6 months of non-compliance; information is automatically exchanged with EU and OECD member states.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and officers are personally liable for the ESR penalty; disqualification from acting as director in Samoa for 5 years; if the activity is also linked to money laundering, criminal liability extends to imprisonment for up to 10 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Shipping controlled pharmaceutical precursors, vaccines requiring special permits, or dual-use cold-chain goods to sanctioned or high-risk jurisdictions with false or missing declarations, or failing to maintain GDP-QC documentation.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Seizure and forfeiture of cargo under the Customs Management Act 2016; monetary penalty up to WST 500,000 or three times the value of the goods; revocation of the GDP freight logistics licence by the Samoa Pharmacy and Poisons Board.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors knowingly involved face criminal liability under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorist Financing Act 2018, including imprisonment of 3 to 7 years and a personal restitution order for all proceeds traceable to the shipment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Missing Registered Agent / Failure to File Annual Return
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the IC without a licensed Samoan registered agent or failing to file the MCIL Form IC-AR and pay the annual Government license fee for two consecutive years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Monthly penalty of WST 500 per month; automatic strike-off from the International Companies Register; assets of the company escheat to the Government of Samoa.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally accountable to indemnify the company for any loss caused by the default; a court may issue a restitution order and a travel prohibition for entry into Samoa.
